newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila Central Bank cuts overnight rates.
newsitem.headline: Manila Central Bank cuts overnight rates.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank has trimmed its overnight rates by 0.25 percentage points, traders said on Thursday.
Its overnight borrowing rate is now 12.75 percent and the overnight lending rate 14.75 percent, they said.
The Philippine Central Bank later confirmed the cuts.

A fall in overnight rates had been expected after the Philippine peso/U.S. dollar market normalised. The peso had fallen prey to the Asian currency turmoil in May caused by Thailand's financial crisis.
But Thursday's small reduction indicated the monetary authorities remained cautious in the light of the renewal of weakness in the Thai baht, traders said.
"We were expecting it to move to as low as 12 percent," a foreign bank dealer said. "However, everytime the Thai baht moves, there is the possibility the peso would be put under pressure."
